evals.prompt: Add a low_stock_threshold integer column (nullable, no default) to closet's item_states table, and note that a later migration will backfill it to 0 and add NOT NULL once the reading code ships.
evals.expected_output: The agent edits apps/api/src/modules/closet/internal/schema.ts, generates the migration with `just db-generate <name>` (never drizzle-kit directly), reviews the generated SQL, writes the paired packages/db/migrations/down/<idx>.sql, states whether the rollback is lossy, adds a forward+rollback test in apps/api/tests/migrations/, and reports that docs/modules/closet.md "Owned data" needs updating.
assertions: The new column is defined in apps/api/src/modules/closet/internal/schema.ts, matching the rule that the module owner edits internal/schema.ts and platform-engineer generates the migration
The agent's report names `just db-generate <name>` as the command used to generate the migration, never a raw drizzle-kit invocation
A packages/db/migrations/down/<idx>.sql file is created pairing the new forward migration, and the report states explicitly whether the rollback is lossy or safe
The migration is additive only (nullable column, no NOT NULL, no rewrite-triggering default) — the backfill and NOT NULL step is explicitly deferred to a later migration, per expand-migrate-contract
The report states that docs/modules/closet.md "Owned data" needs to be updated for the new column

evals.prompt: avatar needs a waist_circumference_cm column on its measurements table so the parametric mesh generator can read it directly instead of recomputing it on every render.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes waist_circumference_cm as sensitive body-measurement data, states its classification, retention, and deletion-propagation in the PR per planning/11-security-privacy-and-compliance.md, ships the column as an additive migration with a paired rollback file, and never invokes drizzle-kit directly — only `just db-generate <name>`.
assertions: The report explicitly classifies waist_circumference_cm as sensitive body-measurement data and states its retention and deletion-propagation handling
The migration is additive (new nullable column) with a paired packages/db/migrations/down/<idx>.sql file, and no DROP/TRUNCATE/NOT NULL step is taken without explicit human authorization
The agent's report names `just db-generate <name>` as the generator, never a raw drizzle-kit invocation
The diff touches only the schema/migration for avatar, not apps/api/src/modules/avatar/internal/ rendering or business logic, and the agent does not silently expand scope into the render layer

evals.prompt: just db-rollback --yes && just db-migrate fails after rolling back 0002_platform_idempotency_keys — the round trip doesn't come back cleanly. Investigate and fix the rollback file.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats this as a regression: it reruns the round trip, pastes the actual failing output, fixes only packages/db/migrations/down/0002.sql to exactly undo the additive step in packages/db/migrations/0002_platform_idempotency_keys.sql (never editing the already-applied forward migration), reruns the round trip, and pastes the passing output.
assertions: The agent's report includes the actual failing round-trip output captured before the fix, not a paraphrase
The fix is confined to packages/db/migrations/down/0002.sql; packages/db/migrations/0002_platform_idempotency_keys.sql (already applied) is never edited
The agent reruns `just db-rollback --yes && just db-migrate` after the fix and pastes the passing output
The report states explicitly whether the corrected rollback is lossy or safe
